subject: Mid-cycle add-on — retro billing & VAT coordination for extra capacity
messages:
From: Accounts Payable <acct_payments@altanova.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marc Tully <marc.tully@altanova.com>, Sara Payne <sara.payne@altanova.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Request: retro invoice for capacity added Aug 10 (VAT)

Hi Sergio,

We just noticed an increase in our reserved capacity on Aug 10 — an additional 20 seats were added to our Dedicated pool (contract DL-10294). Our finance team needs a retroactive invoice that covers Aug 10–Aug 31 for those seats so we can reconcile August spend internally.

A few items we need clarified:
- Please confirm the exact prorated charge for Aug 10–31 (we were charged at go-live rates; want to ensure it's the committed seat price).
- VAT: Altanova is an Irish company — we can provide our VAT ID if you require reverse-charge treatment. If not, confirm rate you will apply.
- Please attach the retro invoice and any supporting calculation.

I have attached the signed addendum that documents the seat increase (signed by Marc).

Thanks,

--
Accounts Payable
Altanova Ltd.
Email: acct_payments@altanova.com
[Attachment: signed_addendum_altanova.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Accounts Payable <acct_payments@altanova.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: retro invoice for capacity added Aug 10 (VAT)

Hi — thanks for the note and for sending the signed addendum. We'll get this sorted. Quick outline of next steps: 

1) I will route to billing ops to calculate the prorated amount for Aug 10–31.
2) We will prepare a retro invoice (or credit note + invoice if necessary) and include a line-by-line calc.
3) VAT: please confirm Altanova's VAT ID so we can determine whether reverse-charge applies.

Laura / Ben — can you confirm the proration method we should use for committed seats on Dedicated? The customer expects daily pro rata based on the committed monthly rate; they were prompted by an automated seat add on. Also advise whether we should apply a 0% reverse-charge placeholder now or wait for VAT ID before finalizing invoice.

Target: send a draft invoice to the customer by EOD tomorrow (26 Aug) so AP can process.

Sergio
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:31:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: retro invoice for capacity added Aug 10 (VAT)

Sergio — taking this. Notes from billing ops / recommended approach: 

- Proration methodology: daily pro rata based on the committed monthly price. Calculation below (committed seat price = €250/month):
  * Additional seats: 20
  * Daily seat cost = €250 / 30 = €8.3333 (we use 30-day month convention for dedicated pricing)
  * Days billed (Aug 10–31 inclusive) = 22 days
  * Charge = 20 seats * €8.3333 * 22 days = €3,666.64 (round to €3,666.64)

- VAT handling: Altanova is EU-based. If they provide a valid VAT ID (intra-EU B2B), we will apply reverse-charge (0% on our invoice, with a note). If no VAT ID is provided, we must apply Irish VAT at 23%.

- Accounting treatment: We will issue an invoice dated Aug 27, 2026 with a description "Retroactive seat add-on (Aug 10–31)". If customer prefers a credit note + new invoice, we can do that — either works for their AR systems. 

Action items for Sergio:
- Confirm which format the customer prefers (single retro invoice vs credit note + invoice).
- Request and attach VAT ID if available.

Action items for Ben / Monica:
- Ben: prepare invoice draft and run through tax code (DL-10294).
- Monica: flag for AR for 30-day payment terms; prepare customer note for internal audit.

Draft invoice attached. I included the calculation lines and the signed addendum reference.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: invoice_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 46KB)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

- Period: Aug 10–31, 2026
- Quantity: 20 additional dedicated seats
- Calculation: daily pro rata (30-day convention)
- Line total (net): €3,666.64
- VAT: reverse-charge pending VAT ID; otherwise 23% Irish VAT (~€843.66) will be added.
- Proposed invoice date: 2026-08-27

If you confirm VAT ID today we can re-issue final invoice with reverse-charge note the same day.

Best,
